request: Stell November und Dezember pro Kategorie nebeneinander.

plan.title: November gegen Dezember
plan.question: Ausgaben im November 2025 und im Dezember 2025 je Kategorie, unkategorisierte Buchungen als 'Needs review', die sechs groessten Kategorien ueber beide Monate, eine Zeile je Kategorie und Monat, der Monat heisst 'November' oder 'Dezember', Spalten topic, period und total_eur.

sql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS name, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY name
  ORDER BY spent DESC
  LIMIT 6
)
SELECT coalesce(v.category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
       CASE WHEN v.booked_on < '2025-12-01' THEN 'November' ELSE 'Dezember' END AS period,
       ROUND(-SUM(v.amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view v
JOIN top ON top.name = coalesce(v.category, 'Needs review')
WHERE v.amount < 0 AND v.booked_on BETWEEN '2025-11-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY topic, period
ORDER BY topic, period

gruppierte Balken stellen die beiden Monate je Kategorie nebeneinander
die Kategorie ist die Position, der Monat ist die Serie, Spalten topic, period, total_eur
der Zeitraum sind November und Dezember 2025

period is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend

request: Compare August with December for each category.

plan.title: August against December
plan.question: Spending in August 2025 and in December 2025 per category, uncategorized bookings as 'Needs review', the six largest categories over both months, one row per category and month, the month named 'August' or 'December', columns topic, period and total_eur.

sql:
WITH top AS (
  SELECT coalesce(category, 'Needs review') AS name, SUM(-amount) AS spent
  FROM transaction_view
  WHERE amount < 0
    AND (booked_on BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-08-31'
         OR booked_on BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31')
  GROUP BY name
  ORDER BY spent DESC
  LIMIT 6
)
SELECT coalesce(v.category, 'Needs review') AS topic,
       CASE WHEN v.booked_on < '2025-09-01' THEN 'August' ELSE 'December' END AS period,
       ROUND(-SUM(v.amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view v
JOIN top ON top.name = coalesce(v.category, 'Needs review')
WHERE v.amount < 0
  AND (v.booked_on BETWEEN '2025-08-01' AND '2025-08-31'
       OR v.booked_on BETWEEN '2025-12-01' AND '2025-12-31')
GROUP BY topic, period
ORDER BY topic, period
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
two months compared per category, so two dimensions that cross
grouped bars put August beside December for each category
the category is the position, the month is the series, columns topic, period, total_eur
the period is August and December 2025
reasoning_code:

the columns are topic, period and total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
period is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
